bodySet: 7 classical (Sefer Yetzirah doubles: Sun, Moon, Mercury..Saturn)
method: readableWords(occupiedLetters(skyAt7(date)), Strong lexicon, null, availableMothers(occupiedSigns)). A word reads iff its simples ⊆ occupied simples AND its mothers ⊆ the geometrically-available mothers (nearest-mother Voronoi zone of the occupied sign(s); 1 mother per single sign). Doubles always lit. Biblical = appears in the Sefaria Hebrew Tanakh (name_refs.json).

permutationTest.summary: actual biblical-proper count vs M random letter↔sign permutations on the same occupied signs; pValue = fraction of permutations reading >= actual.
